descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S18 「第二个会话里的改动，或 Save Note 处理中的改动，不会被 Save Note 撤销」 A change from a second session, or during Save Note processing, is not undone by Save Note

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point.（UAT TC-12；TFA-92590 AC 2；TFA-92590 description） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T3 A deleted Important Point never comes back unless the physician enters it again.（TFA-94699 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes.（UAT TC-12；UAT 3.3；TFA-92590 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Hospital patient with points A and B, editor open in session 1; Nursing Home resident with point D, editor open in session 1

When Session 2 (a runner write) deletes B and adds C on the Hospital patient while session 1's editor is open; session 1 types a note and taps Save Note; while 'Updating structured summary...' shows, session 2 adds F. Nursing Home: session 2 adds E while the editor is open; …

Then Hospital stored list is [A, C, F]; Nursing Home is [D, E, G]: Save Note neither brings B back nor drops C, E, F or G

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：backendChecks after each Save Note completes (U3, T3): Hospital texts == [A, C, F], Nursing Home == [D, E, G]. Main's Hospital usePreRoundProcess writes the list captured at tap time after the parse returns, and Nursing Home rebuilds from the editor box: expected Fail. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S18 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-12.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
